headline: Bitcoin slipped toward $63,000 as US stocks turned lower, with fear still extreme ahead of the Fed's October minutes overnight Bangkok time and Anthropic's share sale pricing tonight in New York.

market.asOf: Read at about 15:53-15:54 UTC Wed 18 Nov (about 22:54 Bangkok) on CoinGecko: BTC $64,008 (down 1.60% in 24 hours), ETH $1,768 (down 1.70%), SOL $74.11 (up 0.60%). CoinMarketCap's bitcoin page showed $63,497 (down 2.07%) at the same time. Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index 12 (10 yesterday, 32 a week ago, 53 a month ago); CoinMarketCap's own Fear & Greed Index 13. Both read at about 15:54 UTC Wed 18 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips toward $63,000 as US stocks turn lower, hours before the Fed's October minutes
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell toward $63,000 as US stocks turned lower after the open. Money is still leaving US bitcoin funds, and traders see a December rate rise as close to certain. Minutes of the Fed's October meeting land at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thursday Bangkok).
points: Bitcoin was 'off more than 2.5% at $63,000 as U.S. stocks turn lower' at 10:48am ET Wednesday, per CoinDesk's live blog.
It fell 14% over the past week, its sixth straight weekly loss, and touched $62,000 on Sunday, per The Block.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had net outflows of $239.94 million on Tuesday 17 Nov, with BlackRock's IBIT losing $209.54 million, per SoSoValue data reported by TokenPost.
CME FedWatch shows a 96% chance of a quarter-point rate rise on 9 December, per Nexo. That is a market bet, not a Fed decision.
Minutes of the Fed's 27-28 October meeting are due at 2:00pm ET Wednesday, per the Federal Reserve's calendar.

stories.title: Anthropic's giant share sale prices tonight in New York, with Nasdaq trading as ANT expected Thursday
stories.summary: AI company Anthropic is due to set the price of its first public share sale on Wednesday evening US time. Reports say demand could push the price above the top of its $70-78 range.
points: The offer is 825 million Class A shares at $70 to $78, listing on the Nasdaq Global Select Market as ANT, per FinanceFeeds.

At $78 the public offering alone raises $64.35 billion; the range values Anthropic at $1.26-1.41 trillion fully diluted, per FinanceFeeds. Bloomberg, via CoinDesk, says at $78 it would raise more than $90 billion.
The Wall Street Journal reports demand could push the price above $80 a share, per FinanceFeeds.

Pricing is expected Wednesday evening US Eastern time (Thursday morning Bangkok), with the first trade Thursday 19 Nov, a date FinanceFeeds attributes to CNBC sources and says the company has not confirmed.

stories.title: Nvidia's post-earnings jump fades at the open despite a big beat
stories.summary: Nvidia's sales came in well above forecasts and it guided higher, and its shares rose before the US open. They gave up those gains in the first minutes of trading. The US also proposed new license rules for AI chip exports to several countries, including Thailand.
points: Adjusted earnings were $2.68 a share against $2.47 expected, and revenue $115.8 billion against $108.8 billion expected; Nvidia guided next quarter to $130 billion, plus or minus 3%, per Kiplinger.
Board chair Harvey Jones said the board 'does not intend' to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO, per Kiplinger.
Nvidia shares 'turned negative after rising as much as 5% in premarket trading', per CoinDesk; Investing.com says shares 'erased early gains in the opening minutes of U.S. trading.'
The US Commerce Department proposed license requirements for AI chip exports to Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore and Brazil, per Kiplinger.

briefs.title: Strategy stock and its preferred shares fall
briefs.summary: Strategy's MSTR fell 4% and its STRC preferred hit its lowest since August at $95.75, per CoinDesk's live blog.

briefs.title: Backpack wins NFA approval for US derivatives
briefs.summary: Backpack now holds FCM, DCM and DCO licenses and plans to offer US users leveraged perpetual futures and event contracts, per The Block.

briefs.title: Website attack tried to swap crypto payment addresses
briefs.summary: Malicious scripts injected through Optimizely reached 178 organizations and tried to swap crypto payment addresses and steal card data, per Reuters via GMA; Optimizely says the flaw is fixed.

briefs.title: StoneX cuts Bitdeer target to $15 over chip export rules
briefs.summary: The cut follows new US licensing rules for advanced chip shipments to Malaysia, per The Block.

briefs.title: CoinShares sells its treasury ether
briefs.summary: CoinShares sold all its treasury ETH and half its SOL, raising $19.3M to fund possible share buybacks, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Bullish shares rise after Q3 results
briefs.summary: Bullish, CoinDesk's parent, rose 7% premarket after Q3 adjusted revenue rose 10% to $84.4M, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: DBS and Circle open 24/7 USDC minting in Asia
briefs.summary: Eligible DBS institutional clients can now swap dollars for USDC and back at any hour, per The Block.

briefs.title: Judge clears the 'MEV brothers' in $25M Ethereum case
briefs.summary: US District Judge Jessica Clarke acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno of fraud and money-laundering conspiracy over an alleged $25M exploit of trading bots, per CoinDesk.

calendar.event: US housing starts and building permits (Oct) – released
calendar.note: Actual: starts 1.309M, up 9.9%, and permits 1.295M, down 7.4%, per the Census Bureau. Starts beat forecasts of 1.27M (Finviz) and 1.240M (TD Economics); the prior was revised to 1.191M from 1.221M, per Seeking Alpha.

calendar.event: Fed minutes from the October meeting
calendar.note: Minutes of the 27-28 October meeting, per the Federal Reserve. Fed's Barr speaks at 1:35pm ET, per the Fed; Williams at 2:30pm ET, per Finviz and TD Economics; Kashkari at 4:15pm ET, per TD Economics.

calendar.event: Anthropic share sale priced, then first Nasdaq trading as ANT
calendar.note: Range $70-78 for 825M shares; the WSJ reports demand could push it above $80, per FinanceFeeds. First trade expected Thursday, per FinanceFeeds citing CNBC; no exact time given.

calendar.event: US jobless claims and Philly Fed survey
calendar.note: Claims forecast 196,000 (Finviz) or 197,000 (TD Economics), prior 200,000; Philly Fed forecast 19.2, prior 20.9, per Finviz. Walmart reports Thursday, per FXStreet. Fed's Hammack speaks at 8:50am ET, per Finviz; Vice Chair Jefferson at 9:25am ET, per the Federal Reserve.
Kristin N. Johnson and Steven Levine, nominated to the SEC, appear before the Senate Banking Committee with other nominees, per the committee's page.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: KAITO, ZRO, ARIA, AKE, MBG, SOON, MON, SOSO, XPL, H
calendar.note: Unlock dates are UTC. KAITO and ZRO on Friday 20, ARIA and AKE on Saturday 21, MBG on Sunday 22, SOON on Monday 23, MON (the largest, about $252M) and SOSO on Tuesday 24, XPL and H on Wednesday 25 November. KAITO's 00:00 UTC unlock is 7:00pm ET Thursday. See the unlock table on this page for sizes, dates and confidence. (Dates from this desk's unlock data.)
About 28,300 BTC, roughly $1.8B, of options expire at 9:00am CET, per CryptoTicker. The bigger monthly expiry, about $5.7B, is Fri 27 Nov.

calendar.event: University of Michigan consumer sentiment (Nov, final)
calendar.note: Forecast 52, per Finviz; the preliminary November reading was 51.0, up from 48.0 in October, per StockAnalysis. Fed's Waller speaks at 8:25am ET and Cook at 12:15pm ET (00:15 Sat Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve.
Prior 91.7, per Newsquawk. Workday reports after the US close, per Workday; Dell also reports, per IfYouSpent.

calendar.event: US GDP (Q3 second estimate) and PCE inflation (Oct)
calendar.note: GDP prior 3.4% (the advance estimate), per the BEA; PCE prior 3.6% a year (core 3.1%), per the BEA. Fed Beige Book at 2:00pm ET, per the Federal Reserve.

calendar.event: Thanksgiving: US stock market closed, then early close
calendar.note: NYSE closed Thursday and closes at 1:00pm ET Friday, per NYSE. A monthly bitcoin options expiry of about 88,000 BTC, or $5.7B, is Friday, per CryptoTicker.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Decision 2:00pm ET Wed 9 Dec (02:00 Thu 10 Dec Bangkok), with new economic projections, per the Federal Reserve. CME FedWatch showed a 96% chance of a 0.25-point rise, per Nexo.
